errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that several slices in both pie charts are exploded or offset from the center (PW, RW, N, NW). This is a significant visual feature used to group or distinguish these categories.

errors.text_span: dark green ("PW") at 4%, dark blue ("NW") at 5%
errors.evidence: When listing the slices for the "All Changes" chart, the description breaks the implied descending order by listing a slice with 4% before a slice with 5%, which is confusing for the reader. A similar issue occurs in the description of the "All Errors" chart.

errors.text_span: and "N" and "PW" being the least frequent
errors.evidence: In both charts, the "N" category is unambiguously the least frequent at 1%. While "PW" is also small (4% and 3%), grouping it with "N" as "the least frequent" is an over-generalization.
